Introduction

Noel is a South Korean male band under S27M Entertainment, composed of four members: Kyunsung, Sungho, Wooseung, and Sanggon. The band debuted through JYP Entertainment on December 16, 2002 with the album "Noel". The group's name translates to "Sunset" in Korean.

In 2013, they left JYP Entertainment and went to YNB Entertainment, where they remained until 2017. At some point, they signed with C-JeS Studios. On July 17, it was announced that they are part of S27M Entertainment.

As of 2024, Noel was still active and has released several digital singles and contributed to various drama soundtracks (OSTs).
